title: Nearly 4,000 US industrial devices exposed to Iranian cyberattacks
summary: The attack surface targeted by Iranian-linked hackers in cyberattacks against U.S. critical infrastructure networks includes thousands of Internet-exposed programmable logic controllers (PLCs) manufactured by Rockwell Automation. [...]

title: Analysis of one billion CISA KEV remediation records exposes limits of human-scale security
summary: Analysis of 1 billion CISA KEV remediation records reveal a breaking point for human-scale security. Qualys shows most critical flaws are exploited before defenders can patch them. [...]

title: CPUID hacked to deliver malware via CPU-Z, HWMonitor downloads
summary: Hackers gained access to an API for the CPUID project and changed the download links on the official website to serve malicious executables for the popular CPU-Z and HWMonitor tools. [...]

title: Microsoft: Canadian employees targeted in payroll pirate attacks
summary: A financially motivated threat actor tracked as Storm-2755 is stealing Canadian employees' salary payments after hijacking their accounts in payroll pirate attacks. [...]

title: Google rolls out Gmail end-to-end encryption on mobile devices
